result.title: Scientist World: Grow a Research World for AI-Scientists
result.summary: AI-Scientists arrived, but a world for them to grow in did not. Human scientists take theirs for granted $-$ centuries of open problems and shared ideas, waiting in the scientific literature. To AI-Scientists, that world is readable but not runnable, so we build Scientist World for them: every research paper becomes an executable environment. Our autonomous pipeline extracts each paper's open-ended research question and reproduces its proposed method as the baseline; an AI-Scientist entering the environment is evaluated against what the human authors achieved. We release the first 1,000 verified environments. With the world as an evaluation, we found that frontier AI-Scientists can already surpass the human researchers 74% of the time. As a record of how AI does science, it contains 6,400 hours of research traces, with every idea, experiment, failure, and success. As a training ground, we are able to raise (+158%) a small model to match frontier models in research ideation. At last, AI-Scientists' own world has arrived, grown from and growing with science itself.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建「Scientist World」：把每篇论文转化为可执行研究环境，自动提取开放问题并复现其方法作基线，让 AI-Scientist 在其中研究并对照人类作者的成果，发布 1000 个已验证环境、6400 小时研究轨迹，并用这些轨迹训练小模型提升研究构思能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉/多模态推理无直接关联，但其「可执行环境 + 长程轨迹记录 + 轨迹训练」的评测与监督思路，可能为 LVR 中推理轨迹的训练、贡献分配和过程评价设计提供参照，可供核查。
